data_description.window_azimuth: The azimuth of the window in degrees (e.g., 180 for South, 270 for West). Best value: Use a compass app while facing out of the window.
data_description.window_view_left: Angle of view to the left from the center of the window (0-180). E.g., 90 means an unobstructed view to the left.
data_description.window_view_right: Angle of view to the right from the center of the window (0-180). E.g., 90 means an unobstructed view to the right.

options.title: HA Blinds Tuning
options.description: Set thresholds, debounce, and movement profile.

data_description.lux_close_summer: Lux threshold to close blinds in summer. Higher = close only in bright sun. Recommended: 35000.
data_description.lux_open_summer: Lux threshold to open blinds in summer. Should be lower than close lux. Recommended: 20000.
data_description.lux_close_winter: Lux threshold to close blinds in winter. Winter sun is lower, might be lower than summer. Recommended: 20000.
data_description.lux_open_winter: Lux threshold to open blinds in winter. Recommended: 12000.
data_description.debounce_minutes: Minutes to wait before reacting to lux changes to prevent flapping. Recommended: 5-10.
data_description.tick_minutes: Frequency of checking/updating blind position. Recommended: 5.
data_description.max_step_per_tick: Max position change per tick to make movement smoother. Recommended: 10.
data_description.heat_start_hour: Hour to start heat protection mode (0-23). Recommended: 10.
data_description.heat_end_hour: Hour to end heat protection mode (0-23). Recommended: 17.
data_description.heat_position: Blind position during heat protection (0-100). Recommended: 20.
data_description.temp_threshold: Temperature above which heat protection activates if an indoor temp sensor is provided. Recommended: 24.0.
data_description.winter_privacy_hour: Hour to close blinds for privacy in winter (0-23). Recommended: 16.
data_description.summer_privacy_hour: Hour to close blinds for privacy in summer (0-23). Recommended: 19.
data_description.privacy_duration_minutes: How long privacy mode remains active after privacy hour starts. Recommended: 480.
data_description.manual_override_minutes: How long to disable auto-control after manual intervention. Recommended: 45.
data_description.zigbee_delay_seconds: Optional delay before each cover command to reduce Zigbee traffic.
data_description.enable_sunset_closing: Enable automatic closing at sunset (with configured offset).
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: Minutes relative to sunset. Negative = before, positive = after.
data_description.sunrise_offset_minutes: Minutes relative to sunrise. Negative = before, positive = after.
data_description.enable_privacy_hour: Enable configured privacy hour closing behavior.
data_description.enable_high_lux_protection: Enable direct sun + high lux closing rule.
data_description.enable_low_lux_reopen: Enable reopen rule when lux stays low.
data_description.enable_sun_elevation_tracking: Enable baseline sun elevation tracking rule.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure HA Blinds
reconfigure.description: Update your blind cover entity, lux sensor, or window orientation.

data_description.temp_sensor: Optional temperature sensor for heat protection
data_description.window_view_left: Angle of view to the left (0-180). 90=unobstructed.
data_description.window_view_right: Angle of view to the right (0-180). 90=unobstructed.

init.title: HA Blinds Options
init.description: Adjust thresholds and timing without re-adding integration. For entity changes, use Reconfigure from the integration menu.

thresholds.title: Threshold Settings
thresholds.description: Adjust lux thresholds for closing/opening blinds, heat protection, and privacy hours.

data_description.lux_close_summer: Lux threshold to close blinds in summer. Higher = close only in bright sun. Recommended: 35000.
data_description.lux_open_summer: Lux threshold to open blinds in summer. Should be lower than close lux. Recommended: 20000.
data_description.lux_close_winter: Lux threshold to close blinds in winter. Recommended: 20000.
data_description.lux_open_winter: Lux threshold to open blinds in winter. Recommended: 12000.
data_description.heat_start_hour: Hour to start heat protection mode (0-23). Recommended: 10.
data_description.heat_end_hour: Hour to end heat protection mode (0-23). Recommended: 17.
data_description.heat_position: Blind position during heat protection (0-100). Recommended: 20.
data_description.temp_threshold: Temperature above which heat protection activates. Recommended: 24.0.
data_description.winter_privacy_hour: Hour to close blinds for privacy in winter (0-23). Recommended: 16.
data_description.summer_privacy_hour: Hour to close blinds for privacy in summer (0-23). Recommended: 19.
data_description.lux_low_threshold: Lux below this means sun is not actually hitting the window (blocked by building, clouds).
data_description.daytime_cloudy_position: Blind position when it is overcast (lux below low threshold, sun not at window).
data_description.movement_threshold: Minimum position difference (%) to trigger a move. Higher = fewer movements, less noise.

timing.title: Timing Settings
timing.description: Adjust check frequency, movement speed, and response timing.

data_description.tick_minutes: Frequency of checking/updating blind position in minutes. Recommended: 5.
data_description.max_step_per_tick: Max position change per tick to make movement smoother. Recommended: 10.
data_description.debounce_minutes: Minutes to wait before reacting to lux changes to prevent flapping. Recommended: 5-10.
data_description.manual_override_minutes: How long to disable auto-control after manual intervention. Recommended: 45.

sunset.title: Sunset/Sunrise Settings
sunset.description: Configure automatic close/open behavior around sunset and sunrise.

data_description.enable_sunset_closing: Enable automatic closing around sunset using sun.sun.
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: Minutes relative to sunset. Negative = before sunset, positive = after sunset.
data_description.sunrise_offset_minutes: Minutes relative to sunrise for reopening behavior. Negative = before sunrise, positive = after sunrise.
data_description.earliest_open_hour: Blinds will never open before this hour, regardless of sunrise or sun position.
data_description.earliest_open_minute: Minute part of the earliest open time (combined with hour above).

features.title: Feature Toggles
features.description: Enable or disable specific automation rules.

data_description.enable_privacy_hour: Auto-close blinds at configured privacy hour.
data_description.enable_high_lux_protection: Close blinds when direct sun and bright light detected.
data_description.enable_heat_protection: Close blinds during heat protection hours if temperature is high.
data_description.enable_low_lux_reopen: Open blinds when light is low.
data_description.enable_sun_elevation_tracking: Base automation: adjust blinds based on sun elevation.
